thesis.core: 2026H1 revenue recovery remains much stronger than core profit conversion, while regulatory/FDA and integration risks are not resolved. The newly completed 18.01% shareholder transfer is a meaningful ownership event but the company states it does not change control, assets or continuing operations, so it does not repair the fundamental valuation gap.
thesis.variant_wedge: Momentum, ownership-event optionality and revenue growth are visible, but current price still capitalizes a much larger normalized core-earnings recovery than disclosed deduct profit and cash economics support.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Retain the prior 2027-style normalized attributable-profit range of RMB25m/RMB60m/RMB100m for bear/base/bull plus RMB0.70bn haircut-adjusted excess liquid-financial assets; do not treat the shareholder transfer as operating earnings.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Fresh review retains prior normalization; the ownership transfer changes shareholder structure but not disclosed operating economics.

catalysts: FDA import alert is formally removed and U.S. syringe shipments normalize.
Cambodia utilization ramps with stable gross margin and cash conversion.
Fenglin Medical integration turns profitable without further balance-sheet deterioration.
The new 18.01% shareholder relationship produces disclosed strategic or commercial synergies rather than remaining a financial ownership event.
kill_thesis: FDA import alert remains unresolved or expands in scope.
Deduct-net-profit margin fails to normalize despite revenue growth.
Inventory/capex/acquisition working capital absorbs cash faster than core profit grows.
Ownership-event expectations rerate the stock without evidence of incremental operating earnings or cash flow.
